Attached Form 3
Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education [Attached Form 3]

APPLICATION FOR DESIGNATION OF A SOCIAL ENVIRONMENTAL EDUCATION INSTITUTION

The applicant shall not complete the dark-shaded fields. Place a check mark (√) in the applicable [ ] box.

Receipt number: __________
Date of receipt: __________
Processing date: __________
Processing period: 30 days

Applicant
Institution name: __________
Corporation [ ] / Unincorporated entity [ ]
Corporate registration number (business registration number): __________
Name of representative: __________
Institution location: __________ (Postal code: __________)
Institution contact details
Telephone number: __________
Email address: __________
Person in charge at the institution
Name: __________
Contact details: __________

Application details
Purpose of establishment of the institution: __________

Particulars of specialized personnel

| Serial number | Name | Date of birth | Duties assigned | Certificates held |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| | | | | |

I hereby apply for designation of a social environmental education institution under Article 15(1) of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education, Article 14 of its Enforcement Decree, and Article 3(1) of its Enforcement Rule.

Year ____ Month ____ Day ____
Applicant: __________ (signature or seal)

To: Special Metropolitan City Mayor / Metropolitan City Mayor / Special Self-Governing City Mayor / Do Governor / Special Self-Governing Province Governor

Accompanying documents
1. One copy of documents confirming compliance with the designation requirements under Article 14 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education.
2. One copy of the social environmental education operating plan.

Fee: None

Processing procedure
Preparation of the application → Receipt → Verification → Approval → Issuance of the certificate of designation of a social environmental education institution.

Applicant: preparation of the application.
Processing authority: Special Metropolitan City / Metropolitan City / Special Self-Governing City / Do / Special Self-Governing Province (department responsible for environmental education).
